q.q: A man walks 6 m towards the east. He turns right. Then he walks 3 m. He turns left. Then he walks 16 m. He turns right. Then he walks 12 m. He turns right. Then he walks 30 m. How far is he from the starting point, and in which direction (from the starting point) is he now?
q.e: Net displacement is 8 m west and 15 m south; distance = √(8² + 15²) = 17 m.
